name: project-risk-system
description: 项目风险管理平台正式工程

scripts.db:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.host-postgres.yml up -d postgres
scripts.db:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.host-postgres.yml logs --tail=100 postgres
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run --frozen ruff check .
scripts.api:check: pnpm api:lint && pnpm api:typecheck && pnpm api:test
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:sync && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi packages/contracts/src/generated
